privileged_info_for_vlm: The task requires setting APP_NAME to 'FitConnect Pro' and DEFAULT_REMOTE_DISPLAY_NAME to 'Fitness Participant' in custom-interface_config.js. It also requires setting config.defaultSubject to 'FitConnect Session' in custom-config.js. Note: While 'defaultSubject' is the requested key in the task, standard Jitsi uses 'subject'; the agent must follow the task instruction to use 'defaultSubject'. The verification screenshot must be saved to /home/ga/Documents/branding_verification.png and the text report to /home/ga/Documents/branding_report.txt.
